shot_stopping.construction: unweighted mean of the component z-scores over the eligible pool
shot_stopping.direction: higher is a better shot stopper for the difficulty of shots faced

sweeping.construction: unweighted mean of the component z-scores over the eligible pool
sweeping.direction: higher is more, and further from goal, defensive action outside the box

distribution.construction: unweighted mean of the component z-scores over the eligible pool
distribution.direction: higher is shorter distribution, fewer launches and a lower average length

cross_handling.construction: unweighted mean of the component z-scores over the eligible pool
cross_handling.direction: higher is a larger share of crosses faced that were stopped

workload.construction: unweighted mean of the component z-scores over the eligible pool
workload.direction: higher is busier and more often beaten, an exposure axis

sign_convention_notes.distribution: launch percentage and average pass length both enter negated, so higher means shorter distribution. A keeper at +1 plays out from the back.
sign_convention_notes.shot_stopping: PSxG per shot on target enters positively as a difficulty adjustment to raw save percentage, which it correlates with at -0.669.

shot_stopping_measure.definition: post-shot expected goals faced minus goals allowed, in goals. Positive means the keeper conceded fewer goals than the difficulty of the shots on target he faced implied.
shot_stopping_measure.supersedes: keepers.gk_saves_above_volume, a residual of total saves regressed on total shots on target faced, which adjusted for shot count and not shot difficulty.
